source_note: Weierstrass逼近定理的概率途径证明
english_source_note: A Probabilistic Proof of the Weierstrass Approximation Theorem
callout_id: Weierstrass逼近定理的概率途径证明#10
english_title: Dominated Convergence Theorem for Convergence in Probability
statement_en:
If random variables $X_n\xrightarrow{P}{X}$, and if $|X_n|\leq Y$ with $E(Y)$ finite, then
$$E(X_n)\to E(X).$$
callout_body: 任意随机变量$X_n\xrightarrow{P}{X}$，如果$|X_n|\leq Y$,并且$Y$的期望存在，那么$$E(X_n)\to E(X)$$
